To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
initializing a recurrent network of rectified linear unit to a scaled identity matrix is a simple way to obtain a good initialization for long-term dependencies.

(1) recurrent networks composed of rectifier nonlinearities can be trained to learn long-term dependencies, (2) initializing the recurrent weight matrix with the identity matrix or a scaled version of it can help train recurrent networks of rectified linear neurons to learn long-term temporal dependencies and that (3) our proposed method is comparable to the performance of standard implementations of LSTMs.

1) recurrent neural networks composed solely of rectified linear unit (ReLU) activations are able to learn long-term dependencies on four different benchmarks; 2) initializing the recurrent weight matrix with the identity matrix or a scaled version thereof is crucial; 3) the performance of the networks can be improved by using a small number of hidden layers and a small number of neurons per hidden layer.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a simple way to initialize RNNs composed of rectified non-linearities.

the following question: is there a simple way to initialize recurrent neural networks of rectified linear unit that can learn long-term dependencies without sophisticated architectures or optimization algorithms?
a simple solution to the problem of vanishing and exploding gradient in recurrent neural networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is a simple, yet effective solution to the vanishing gradient problem in recurrent neural networks.
our solution is a viable and simple alternative to the LSTM.

our solution performs as well as a standard implementation of an LSTM on the language modeling task, but it does not perform as well as a state-of-the-art implementation on the speech recognition task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a simple and effective way to initialize RNNs with rectified linear units, which can be used as a replacement to LSTMs.
our simple solution is comparable to LSTMs on the four benchmarks.
our solution is simpler and more robust than standard implementations of LSTMs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
recurrent neural networks of rectified linear activations can be used for learning long-term temporal dependencies without any of the sophisticated techniques that have previously been proposed.
recurrent networks of rectified linear unit can be initialized in a simple manner to learn long-range temporal dependencies.
simple solutions are worth exploring before resorting to more sophisticated solutions.
